decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the core postpress portfolio and kept its own page through 2024 while several 2023 launches were removed, so it appears to meet aspirations and needs no problemistic search.

The folding add-on unit is close to the established offer and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, which justifies keeping it as a low-cost complement to the modular finishing line, even though its presence on the website is only a mention.
